name: The Truth of the Empty Room
description:
An empty room is not always as quiet as it looks.

Ever glanced at a picture and felt that one little detail was trying to tell you something? This laid-back visual quiz is all about taking a proper look and picking up the clue.

Check each scene, think over the question, and choose the one spot in the image that matches the answer.

・Scan the whole picture carefully
・Find the area that fits the question
・Select that single spot to answer

It is easy to jump in for a quick go, but every scene gives your observation, logic and curiosity a neat little workout.

Have another look and see what truth the room gives away.
